source.title: Call for Applicants - WST Members (March 2021)
source.content:
The **WCA Software Team** is seeking new members! The WST plays a central role in the WCA by developing, scaling, and maintaining the software solutions that help the organization handle the continuous community growth.

Some examples of such software solutions are:

* The WCA website, that you are probably browsing on a regular basis.
* TNoodle, the scrambles library and its frontend, used by all Delegates during competitions.
* WCA Live, which is the main platform for score taking and getting live results during competitions.

All WST projects are open source and hosted on the [organization's GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/).

While anyone is encouraged to apply, we are also looking for some specific roles - and if you fit these requirements, please let us know in your application:

* Project Manager: Manage tasks and issues along with priorities on Github as well as managing any software needs from WCA teams/committees and keep them up to date.
* Client Side Developer: Work on the user-facing parts of the WCA Website including working on the ongoing project of porting parts of the site to React. Enhance user experience and satisfaction.
* Developer Operations: Work on deployment strategies (our platform runs on AWS) and address any issues/improvements to be made.
<!-- break -->
Most of the WST projects are web-oriented, which is reflected by the technologies used:

* The website is written on top of the Ruby on Rails framework (using an SQL database), with some front-end components written in React. We're looking to move forward with its redesign process by migrating more heavily used parts to React.
   * This is by far the most understaffed project, as we constantly receive new feature requests by the various growing WCA teams and committees.
   * You can have a relatively high level idea of website-related projects by taking a look [here](https://github.com/thewca/worldcubeassociation.org/projects).
* WCA Live is written in React for the front-end and Elixir for the backend GraphQL API (checkout its [high level documentation](https://github.com/thewca/wca-live/blob/master/README.md)).
* TNoodle is split into a scrambling library written in java (tnoodle-lib), and a server (tnoodle) that contains a Kotlin back-end+React front-end.

All our projects labelled with "[good first issue](https://github.com/thewca/worldcubeassociation.org/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)" are those that you could take a look at to get an idea of what we expect from first time contributors. Please note that you do not need to be experienced in any or all aspects of the technologies mentioned here. A fundamental understanding of software as well as willingness and dedication to learn are the only requirements for this position.

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until **March 31st, 2021** to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be submitted in PDF format, and should include the following:

* Your Name
* A brief personal summary
* A summary of involvement in the WCA
* An summary of your technical background and experience
* Aspirations as a member of the WCA Software Team

Thank you for your applications and support!

translation.title: WCA 软件组招募成员（2021 年 3 月）
translation.content:
**WCA 软件组**正在招募新成员！WST 负责开发、扩展和维护各类软件，帮助 WCA 应对社区的持续增长，是组织的重要组成部分。

这些软件包括：

* 你可能经常访问的 WCA 网站。
* TNoodle：所有代表在比赛中使用的打乱库及其前端。
* WCA Live：比赛录入成绩及查看实时成绩的主要平台。

WST 的全部项目均为开源项目，托管在 [WCA 的 GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/) 上。

我们欢迎所有人申请，同时也在寻找以下特定岗位的人选。如果你符合条件，请在申请中说明：

* 项目经理：管理 GitHub 上的任务、问题及优先级，协调 WCA 各团队和委员会的软件需求，并及时向他们通报进展。
* 前端开发：开发 WCA 网站面向用户的部分，包括正在进行的部分页面 React 迁移工作，改善用户体验与满意度。
* 开发运维：负责部署方案，处理相关问题并改进现有系统。我们的平台运行于 AWS。
<!-- break -->
WST 的大多数项目以 Web 为主，所用技术如下：

* 网站基于 Ruby on Rails 框架，使用 SQL 数据库，部分前端组件用 React 编写。我们希望将更多常用部分迁移到 React，推进网站改版。
  * 这是目前最缺人手的项目。随着 WCA 各团队和委员会不断发展，我们持续收到新的功能需求。
  * 网站相关项目的概况可在[此处](https://github.com/thewca/worldcubeassociation.org/projects)查看。
* WCA Live 前端使用 React，后端 GraphQL API 使用 Elixir，参见[项目概览文档](https://github.com/thewca/wca-live/blob/master/README.md)。
* TNoodle 分为 Java 编写的打乱库 tnoodle-lib，以及包含 Kotlin 后端和 React 前端的服务器 tnoodle。

你可以查看标有“[good first issue](https://github.com/thewca/worldcubeassociation.org/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)”的问题，了解我们对首次参与贡献者的期望。请注意，你不需要已经掌握上述某项或全部技术。申请这一岗位，只需具备软件基础知识，并愿意认真学习。

申请从即日起开放，请于 **2021 年 3 月 31 日**前将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

* 姓名。
* 简短的个人介绍。
* 参与 WCA 事务的经历。
* 技术背景和经验概述。
* 作为 WCA 软件组成员的工作目标。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
